findings.what: decodeURIComponent runs on every dev request before the /trace filter, so a malformed %-escape on any path throws URIError and becomes a 500 instead of reaching Vite
findings.why: The decode is only needed for /trace.json and /trace/* (the traversal guard at :55-56). Running it ahead of the path check changes how every other dev request is handled, which no rule asks for (code-quality: invented behaviour).
